plugin.name: Framework (always installed)
plugin.description:
The DeD Framework - the always-installed core. This includes the framework esp (the MCM host), ALL scripts (the script core is one link-time unit - module scripts are referenced by name from the shared core and always ship), the Baka UI DLL and offsets config, the shared interaction content pack (the non-pose actions, prompts, and triggers the interaction core uses), the interaction sounds, and the interact/execute/HUD menus.
You cannot deselect this. The module options below are real file toggles - each installs exactly its own files (esp, DLL, content layer, assets) and nothing else; the mod runs with any combination of them, including none.

plugin.name: Baka Interactions
plugin.description:
Baka's Animations integration - the interaction core: escalation, downed states, spank, capture, reactions, modesty, SexLab cues, the Execute action, and the interact/encounter/downed/mid-combat/sex-spank menus.
Without this module you lose every interaction action (flirt, harass, escalate, capture, spank, execute and the rest of the non-pose action set), the Baka menus, and the slave-trade paths. The framework MCM still opens; its Baka pages show empty-state text.
Prerequisites: none. SexLab is optional at runtime - without it, scenes fall back to plain pairing (the bridge no-ops).

plugin.name: GS Poses
plugin.description:
Solo posing - the crosshair pose grid, the Power of Poses, and the muse (idle NPCs considering and striking poses on their own).
Without this module you lose solo posing, the pose grid, the muse, and the GS Poses MCM page. Everything else works; the pose actions are simply absent from the LLM menu.
Note on combinations: with the Baka Interactions module OFF, a few muse vocabulary names skip gracefully (they log guarded skips, not errors) - the muse runs on the reduced vocabulary either way.
Prerequisites: none.

plugin.name: Cum Detection
plugin.description:
LLM cum cues - the narrator sees when an actor is filled and reacts: swelling, warmth, dripping arousal content for OCum and SexLab scenes.
Without this module you lose the cum cues (sdb_cum_applied and the SexLab stage-end cue). Nothing else changes.
Prerequisites: OCum OR SexLab at runtime - the module no-ops and the MCM section greys out without either. Without its prerequisite, this module is inert; nothing breaks.

plugin.name: FHU Inflation
plugin.description:
LLM inflation cues - Fill Her Up belly inflation narrated as it happens: swelling on level-up, release on level-down, read from FHU's own per-actor state.
Without this module you lose the inflation cues only. Nothing else changes.
Prerequisites: Fill Her Up at runtime - the poll never arms without it and the MCM section greys out. Without its prerequisite, this module is inert.

plugin.name: SlaveTats
plugin.description:
Degradation tattoos - SlaveTats sets that accumulate with spank/defeat/escalation play: spank marks, tears, drool, the defeated look. Includes the in-game set-picker.
Without this module you lose the tattoo sets, the picker, and the SlaveTats MCM section. If the Acheron Bridge is installed, its defeat marks (applied by this module) disappear with it. The spank/defeat/escalation hooks simply idle.
Note: if both OSL Aroused (Reborn) and SL Aroused (NG) are installed together, our runtime chain uses Reborn first, then SL Aroused, then neutral - you should run only one arousal framework.
Prerequisites: SlaveTats (which includes JContainers) at runtime - without it, this module is inert.

plugin.name: Acheron Bridge
plugin.description:
Downed-state bridge - defeat handoff between Acheron and this mod: downed actors get the interact menu, the Downed State MCM page, and Acheron action icons.
Without this module you lose the Acheron-side integration (consequence handoff, its YAMLs, the Downed State page). The mod keeps its own defeat/downed logic independent of Acheron.
Prerequisites: Acheron at runtime - the bridge only arms when Acheron is present. Without it, this module is inert.

plugin.name: Arousal Framework Check
plugin.description:
Install-time check only - installs NOTHING (this option has no files). Read this before you install.
Arousal framework status: this option shows "not recommended" (greyed) when BOTH an OSL Aroused esp (OSLAroused.esp - the Reborn framework) and an SL Aroused esm (SexLabAroused.esm - the NG framework) are detected active in your load order.
What the check can and cannot see (read this): OSL Aroused Reborn SHIPS its own copy of SexLabAroused.esm, so a Reborn-only install ALSO trips this check - the installer cannot tell which mod folder provided a plugin. If you run Reborn alone, ignore the grey-out and simply keep this option unchecked.
If you deliberately run SL Aroused (NG) alongside OSL Aroused (Reborn), you have two arousal frameworks active at once. Nothing breaks: our runtime chain reads arousal from Reborn first (side-effect-free), then SL Aroused, then runs with no arousal features - but you should keep only ONE arousal framework active. Disable one in MO2's plugin list (right pane).
If NEITHER arousal framework is installed: no arousal content is generated (poses, reactions and cues run neutral) - the mod otherwise works fully. No in-game check can be done at install time; this is a load-order file check only.
